Oracle Fusion Financials 26B: what changed

We track 25 Financials changes in 26B, out of 48 features (our count) in Oracle's 26B What's New documents for this area. 19 of them are delivered switched on; 6 need setup or an opt-in before anyone can use them.

Get the 26D checklist now: what switches on by itself, which former opt-ins are now standard, what to test

Inside the free 26D checklist (PDF):

  • The 23 opt-ins Oracle lists as ending with 26D: 9 switch on for everyone, 14 need setup
  • 9 HCM Redwood default switches and other HCM notices for 26D
  • 9 baseline regression checks, plus typical 26D test and production dates by cohort

Oracle sources: Financials 26B What's New · Risk Management 26B What's New · Self Service Financials 26B What's New

Impact on upgrade is our editorial rating of how much a change affects existing users and testing; Oracle scale is Oracle's own rating. Always confirm details on the linked Oracle page.

Delivered switched on (19)

Legislative Updates for Fiscal Document Generation Layout supporting Brazil VAT Reform

Impact on upgrade: highOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Local Compliance & Reporting
Stay compliant with the latest legislative changes impacting fiscal document layouts for Brazil VAT reform. Legislative updates are provided to address requirements introduced during government testing and the initial application phase of the new VAT rules.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Accounting for Multiple Partner Contributions in Stakeholder Billing

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Joint Venture Settlement
When a stakeholder bill includes distributions funded by partner contributions with different accounts, Joint Venture Management now creates a separate accounting entry and invoice line for each partner contribution.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Automated Revenue Recognition for Sales Invoices with Prepayment Applications

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Receivables Invoice Processing
Sales invoices that include prepayment application lines can now have revenue schedules on their standard lines, using invoicing and revenue scheduling rules. The prepayment application lines themselves now default to the Immediate revenue scheduling rule.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Landed Cost Line Classification of Payables Invoices from File-Based Data Import

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Payables Invoice Processing
The Payables Invoice Import spreadsheet gets a Landed Cost Enabled flag per invoice line. Lines set to Y go to Landed Cost Management for variance calculation and allocation. The column is hidden and blank by default, so existing imports are unchanged.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Partner Contribution Invoice for Distribution Only Stakeholders

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Joint Venture Settlement
Generate partner contribution invoices for stakeholders whose invoicing preference is set to "Create Invoices," regardless of whether "Distribution Only" is enabled for the stakeholders or the ownership definition.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Payment Justification and Program Record Inclusion in PAM Payment File

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)FinancialsFinancials · U.S. Federal Treasury Reporting and Interfaces
Include the payment justification and program record in Payment Automation Manager, or PAM, payment files to comply with updated U.S. Department of the Treasury requirements.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Service Excellence Continuing Investments

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Performance and Stability
A bundle of small usability, resiliency, performance and security fixes across Financials, for example an optional control that stops users deleting global intercompany invoices from the Payables Correct Import Errors spreadsheet. Check Oracle's page for the full list.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Virtual Card Reconciliation with Multiple Settlements

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Virtual Card
Reconcile virtual card payments when suppliers process multiple settlements against a single virtual card. This feature ensures accurate reconciliation by matching all related transactions to the corresponding virtual card, and recording the card statement accurately.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Account Alias for Joint Venture Accounts

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Joint Venture Settlement
Joint Venture Management pages (partner contributions, source transactions, JV definitions, ownership assignment rules and overhead methods) now let you pick an account alias instead of typing every account segment.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Deep Links for Budget Entries and Budgetary Control Balances

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Planning and Budgeting
Use deep links to the Review Budget Entries and Review Budgetary Control Balances pages to access budgetary control inquiry pages directly from reports and dashboards.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

E-Reporting for France

Impact on upgrade: lowAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Local Compliance & Reporting
Submit detailed Payables invoices and reports for French overseas territories (DROM-COM) electronically to the French tax authorities using designated service providers.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Report · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Japanese Corporate Tax Schedule 16 Reports Compliance

Impact on upgrade: lowAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Legislative Updates
The Japanese Corporate Tax Schedule 16 reports follow the National Tax Agency's updated templates: they can show global descriptive flexfields from Add Asset and Adjust Asset, use the revised era name and include asset category descriptions.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Report · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Lease Payables Processing for Approved Payments

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)FinancialsFinancials · Asset Acquisition, Maintenance, and Lease
Export only approved lease payments to Oracle Fusion Cloud Payables for payment processing. Lessees typically pay their lessors and other parties associated with their leases each period for rent, service, insurance, common area maintenance charges, or other amounts included in the leases.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Lease Transactions and Balances Report Improvements

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)FinancialsFinancials · Asset Acquisition, Maintenance, and Lease
Use the Lease Transactions and Balances report to summarize the right-of-use asset and liability balances and changes. Lease administrators can now view the accounted right-of-use asset and liability balances and transaction activity in both the ledger currency and the entered currency.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Payroll Encumbrance and Liquidation

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)FinancialsFinancials · Planning and Budgeting
The Payroll Encumbrance feature enables organizations to proactively reserve funds for estimated payroll expenses before payroll is processed. By recording anticipated payroll obligations in advance, organizations gain improved budget control, stronger financial visibility, and better alignment between workforce planning and financial management.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Receivables Invoice Installment Creation Using a REST API

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Receivables Invoice Processing
Create Receivables invoice installments using the Receivables Invoices REST API. This feature enhances flexibility for users to automate the installment creation process, and adapt payment schedules to customer needs.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Supplier and Customer Default Trading Partner TAS Update

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)FinancialsFinancials · U.S. Federal Treasury Reporting and Interfaces
Automatically update the Trading Partner Treasury Account Symbol, or Trading Partner TAS, on Supplier Sites and Customer Accounts when it reaches its expiration date.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

System for Award Management Import for Customers

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)FinancialsFinancials · U.S. Federal Treasury Reporting and Interfaces
U.S. federal agencies can now create customer records from imported System for Award Management (SAM) data, not just supplier records.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

New Advanced Access Requests Subject Area

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onFinancialsRisk Management · Transactional Business Intelligence for Risk Management
The new Risk Management Cloud - Advanced Access Request Real Time subject area provides built-in reporting and analytics for monitoring access-request activity, approvals, and associated risk.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Needs setup or opt-in (6)

Revenue Equipment Leases

Impact on upgrade: mediumOpt-in, expires 26DFinancialsFinancials · Asset Acquisition, Maintenance, and Lease
Create operating revenue lease contracts for equipment. Details of the lease include terms of the lease, asset details, parties, billing schedules, milestones, rights, and obligations.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Opt In plus Setup · Oracle source

AI Agent: B2B Message Converter - Enrich Workflow Features Along with Upload and Download Capabilities

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upFinancialsFinancials · Collaboration Messaging
You can use the B2B Message Converter AI agent to streamline the conversion of B2B messages such as shipments from a Fusion Application REST resource into industry-standard formats.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Additional Governance for Bank Account Transfers and Ad Hoc Payments

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upFinancialsFinancials · Payment Execution Options
Make use of additional governance for bank account transfer and ad hoc payment processes. Capture payment information during bank account transfers and ad hoc payments.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Cash Processing from Bank Statements and Remittance Advices

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set up (Service Request Required)FinancialsFinancials · Cash Processing Agent
Receipts can now be created automatically from bank statement lines, and remittance advices in several formats are read and matched to receipts in one flow. In 26B it's for early adopters only, enabled through a service request.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Service Request Required · Oracle source

Data Extraction Using Read-Only Replicated Data

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upFinancialsFinancials · Integration & Extensibility
Extract data with improved reliability and speed, with less impact on core application performance. The simplified extraction experience includes support for full or incremental extracts, on-demand runs or schedules, and status monitoring.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Embedded Receivables E-Invoice Integration with Thomson Reuters

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upFinancialsFinancials · Receivables Invoice Processing
Use the integration with Thomson Reuters to send Receivables e-invoices to your customers. Receivables uses the Document IO agent to extract, transform, and deliver receivables transactions in electronic formats.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

All 48 Financials features in Oracle's 26B What's New
